name: GriffithWilson

frame.axes: x = m east of SW corner, z = m north, y = elevation - 120

gps.note: EXIF compass is magnetic; +12 deg to true in Los Angeles County (2026)

notes: course.json carries both coursekit's keys (size, sw_e, sw_n, y_offset, epsg, terrain_height, lidar_survey, gkd) and the toolkit's (frame, paths, lidar, holes, gps); keep both in step.

Frame is the Griffith Park frame shared with Harding (same square, SW corner, y_offset). heightmap_2049.raw here is the shared heightmap levelled under Wilson's tee pads (scripts/flatten_pads.py, tee_pads.csv); the folder had its own copy of heightmap and satellite, nothing was copied from griffith-park/.
trees.csv holds 2,256 LiDAR trees for both courses (vegetation was run with the whole-park map and --parkland); Harding in the middle is OB.
Check the long interior OB strip in the woods west of 17/18 against the flyover; it may be playable woods.
White tees sit on real boxes 11 yds long of the card on 1 and 2, 6 yds on 5 (Combo too on 5).
green_slopes.csv: 12 greens over 3% overall slope (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 13, 15, 16, 17; steepest 17 at 4.8%), not smoothed.
scripts/coursekit.py is Wilson's copy of coursekit with the collar, bunker and LA River changes.
Flyovers from BoJa: front 9 https://youtu.be/zK3th5k1jfM, back 9 https://youtu.be/8REieRe2TAQ.
